prompt: Use the attached original ONLY as the exact design authority. Make a production 2D death-animation spritesheet: 4 columns x 4 rows, 16 complete drawings, equal square cells, genuine transparent background. No text, labels, gridlines, ground shadows, scenery or extra objects. Same left-facing three-quarter camera, original soft painted game-sprite rendering and restrained outline. Keep EXACT character proportions, volumes, palette, anatomy and markings. One fixed drawing scale and ground baseline through all cells; each complete character stays inside its cell with margins, without individual zooming or centering. Read left-right/top-bottom. Draw actual joint movement, perspective and overlaps, with no detached parts, transparent ghosts, flattened bodies or rubber stretching. The images are the final animation source cels, so every inbetween must make physical sense. Early cels show loss of support; middle cels carry weight onto the ground; late cels settle with slower secondary motion. Closed eyes after support fails. Preserve the original impression and body size through all 16 cels. Character: the original cream round-headed spring-keeper bird: tiny gold beak, dark eye, wide coral/cream petal ruff, overlapping sage green folded wing feathers, short gold legs and the exact cream/coral flame-shaped crest and ornate tail fan. Preserve their count, attachments and broad shapes. Action cels 1-4: exact neutral stance, blink, head/neck become heavy and chest tips forward as both knees bend. 5-8: legs lose support, bird rolls slightly onto its near side, folded wing stays attached, breast makes first contact, head and beak descend. 9-12: cheek/beak settle on the ground, legs curl naturally below/behind the round body; tail fan falls with the body and its feathers relax along the ground behind it. The crest bends from its actual forehead roots, tips following with a short delay, and drapes forward over the visible eye. 13-16: small contact recoil then settling, final lifeless side-lying bird with a fully covered eye, round head/body intact, connected folded green wing and a relaxed tail fan lying behind it. No standing flame crest, no cutout seams, no detached green leaves, no rigid upright tail after collapse. Make the moment of first contact and the falling crest gradual across multiple drawings.
